findings.highlight: The cold weight of death pushes in only a few centimeters, stopping just short of my heart.
findings.evidenceJa: わずか数センチ、一押しするだけで心臓を穿つ、冷酷な死の重み。
findings.governingReading: Blade at his back needs only a further push of a few centimeters to pierce heart.
findings.explanation: Potential centimeters to heart become enacted thrust depth.
